SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MIDDLESEX COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26002095
DOCKET NO. F00860725
PLAINTIFF – CREDIT UNION OF NEW JERSEY, A FEDERAL CREDIT UNION, FORMERLY KNOWN AS CREDIT UNION OF NEW JERSEY, A STATE CHARTERED CREDIT UNION
DEFENDANTS- ABDUL AZIZ, ET ALS.
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Wednesday The 4th Day of November 2026
between the hours of twelve and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 1:30 P.M. prevailing time at The Heldrich Hotel, 10 Livingston Avenue, New Brunswick, New Jersey 08901 to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the TOWNSHIP of PISCATAWAY, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: LOT 9.21 BLOCK 11701
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
10 WALDHAVEN COURT PISCATAWAY, NJ 08854
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Middlesex County Clerk.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
All that certain lot, piece or parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon erected, situate, lying and being in the Township of Piscataway, County of Middlesex and State of New Jersey:
Street Address: 10 Waldhaven Court, Piscataway, New Jersey 08854
Nearest Cross Street: Hoes Lane West
Tax Lot and Block No.: Lot 9.21, Block 11701; on the Tax Map of the Township of Piscataway, Middlesex County, New Jersey.
Dimensions: 136 feet x 120 feet Irregular.
Amount Due for Taxes: Taxes are current through the second quarter 2026.
As the above description does not constitute a full legal description, said full legal description is annexed to that certain mortgage recorded in the Office of the Clerk/Register of Middlesex County on February 26, 2020 in Mortgage Book o Book 17795, at Page 550 and the Writ of Execution on file with the Sheriff of Middlesex County.
The above figures for taxes were furnished to the Law Firm of Peter J. Liska, LLC by the Tax Collector’s Office of the Township of Piscataway and the accuracy of said figures must be verified by any Interested party as Plaintiff makes no representations as to the accuracy of same either express or implied. Accordingly, you must check with the Tax Collector to verify the exact amount due.
The Lender's upset price for bidding at the Sheriff's Sale is APPROXIMATELY $501,000.00. LENDER RESERVES THE RIGHT TO AMEND THE UPSET PRICE PRIOR TO SALE, AND FURTHER, AMEND THE UPSET PRICE TO INCLUDE FUTURE ORDERS FOR ADDITIONAL SUMS EXPENDED AFTER FINAL JUDGMENT, IF ANY.
Subject to any other unpaid taxes, assessments, water and sewer liens, if any.
DISCLAIMER: The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn the sale without further notice through publication.
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Middlesex County Clerk’s Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $501,483.23 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration, are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
MILDRED S. SCOTT
SHERIFF
DATED: September 22, 2026
PETER J. LISKA, LLC
766 SHREWSBURY AVENUE
TINTON FALLS, NJ 07724
(856) 596-8900
